stem: What distinguishes variable life insurance from other forms of life insurance?
options: Its cash value earns a guaranteed minimum interest rate
Its death benefit is limited to the premiums paid
Its cash value varies with investments the owner chooses
Its premiums are set by the state insurance department
key: Its cash value varies with investments the owner chooses

stem: If the investment options a variable life policyowner selects perform poorly, the owner:
options: Keeps a guaranteed minimum cash value
Receives a refund of premiums from the insurer
Can lose earnings, but not the initial investment
Could lose money, including the initial investment
key: Could lose money, including the initial investment

stem: A client wants somewhere to keep savings for 18 months. Why is variable life insurance generally unsuitable for that goal?
options: Costs and tax consequences that outweigh short-term gains
Tax-deferred growth, which suits short-term goals
Fees that are lower than a bank savings account
Guaranteed returns over periods under two years
key: Costs and tax consequences that outweigh short-term gains

stem: At age 70, Dana buys an annuity with one lump-sum payment, and her monthly income checks begin a few weeks later. Dana bought:
options: A deferred annuity
An immediate annuity
A variable life policy
A registered index-linked annuity

stem: In a deferred annuity, the period during which money grows tax-deferred before income payments begin is called the:
options: Payout phase
Annuitization period
Accumulation phase
Free-look period

stem: During the accumulation phase, what does a fixed deferred annuity guarantee?
options: Its current interest rate for the life of the contract
Returns tied to a stock index
Withdrawals free of surrender charges
A floor on credited interest

stem: The benchmark index for Ray's fixed indexed annuity falls 12% during a one-year term. The interest credited to his annuity for that term is:
options: Zero at worst
Negative 12%
Negative, but limited by a buffer
Negative, offset by the guaranteed minimum

stem: Which type of deferred annuity can credit negative interest, reducing contract value, when its benchmark index performs poorly?
options: Fixed annuity
Registered index-linked annuity (RILA)
Fixed indexed annuity
Immediate annuity

stem: Which type of annuity lets the owner direct contributions among a menu of mutual funds, with no limit on gains or losses?
options: Fixed annuity
Fixed indexed annuity
Variable annuity
Registered index-linked annuity

stem: Which two types of deferred annuities are securities that must register with the SEC?
options: Fixed annuities and fixed indexed annuities
Fixed annuities and RILAs
Fixed indexed annuities and variable annuities
RILAs and variable annuities

stem: In a registered market value adjustment (MVA) annuity, what can happen if the owner withdraws money before the specified period ends?
options: The contract value may be adjusted, often downward
The insurer must credit a bonus interest rate
The fixed rate converts to an index-linked rate
Nothing, since the fixed rate is locked in
key: The contract value may be adjusted, often downward

stem: The guarantees in an annuity contract are backed primarily by:
options: FDIC deposit insurance
The issuing insurer's claims-paying ability
The SEC's investor protection fund
The performance of a stock index

stem: A $100,000 life policy was issued based on a misstated age. At the insured's true age, the premium paid would have bought only $88,000 of coverage. At death, the insurer pays:
options: $100,000 minus the premium shortfall

stem: A New Jersey life insurer receives due proof of death on May 1 and finds nothing that needs investigation. Settlement must be made no later than:
options: May 31
June 15
June 30
July 30

stem: A New Jersey producer wants to make a sales call at 6:30 p.m. Eastern time to a prospect at home in California, where it is 3:30 p.m. Under the federal calling-hour rule, the call is:
options: Prohibited, because it is after 6 p.m. for the caller
Prohibited, because interstate sales calls need written consent
Permitted only with a recorded disclosure at the start
Permitted, because it is 3:30 p.m. where the prospect is
key: Permitted, because it is 3:30 p.m. where the prospect is

stem: A client bought a single-premium policy from an agency 20 months ago and has had no other dealings with it since. Her number is on the national do-not-call registry. May the agency make a sales call to her?
options: Yes, because she is a past customer
Yes, because registrations expire after five years
Yes, as long as the call is made before 9 p.m.
No, because the 18-month business relationship has ended
key: No, because the 18-month business relationship has ended

stem: A 61-year-old withdraws $10,000 of taxable earnings from a nonqualified deferred annuity. The additional 10% federal penalty tax on this withdrawal is:
Jordan, age 17, completes his prelicensing course and passes the New Jersey producer exam. When can the commissioner approve his resident producer license?
options: Once he turns 18
Immediately, since he passed the exam
Once he turns 21
Only with a parent's written consent

stem: A producer's license renewal fee was due June 30. She does not pay it until May 15 of the following year. What is the result?
options: She must retake the licensing exam
She may reinstate without an exam, though a late penalty may apply
Her license is reinstated with no penalty
She must wait 90 days and then reapply
key: She may reinstate without an exam, though a late penalty may apply

stem: The commissioner issues a temporary producer license to a deceased producer's spouse on March 1. Absent a new license, the latest it can remain in effect is about:
options: March 31
June 1
August 28
March 1 of the next year

stem: A licensed agency pays a referral fee to an unlicensed real estate agent who only passes along a client's name and never discusses coverage. Under New Jersey's licensing law, this payment is:
options: Prohibited, since the real estate agent is unlicensed
Permitted only if she becomes licensed within 90 days
Prohibited unless the commissioner approves it in advance
Permitted, since she only referred the client
key: Permitted, since she only referred the client

stem: John has two policies on his life with the same insurer, with death benefits of $300,000 and $350,000. The insurer becomes insolvent. The guaranty association's maximum obligation for John's death benefits is:
After a hearing, a producer is found to have knowingly made three misleading policy comparisons in violation of New Jersey's life trade practice rules. The maximum total penalty is:
